Its constructor injects EmployeeRepository and TimesheetRepository from the persistence layer. The layer model lets the business layer depend on persistence, so this is allowed dependency wiring, not misplaced I/O. None of its signatures or throw statements use a request, response, HTTP context, status code or HTTP error. The errors it throws (PayrollRuleError, UnknownRecordError) are types the project declares in src/business/model. It has no framework or ORM decorators or base classes. It does no direct I/O: it creates no database, ORM, HTTP or file client and uses no global accessor. The logic it contains is domain logic: the 0–80 weekly hours limit, the check for an active employee, approving timesheets and computing payslips. No candidate flags were raised.
